ValidationRule.description: Cancelled Status can only be used by Sys Admin and OneTrust Integration profiles as of now
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( AND ($Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "OneTrust Integration"), OR( AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Cancelled")), AND( ISCHANGED( Status ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Cancelled") ), AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c, "Cancelled")), AND( ISCHANGED( NSP_Status__c ), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c, "Cancelled") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to set the status to "Cancelled" at this time.
